title: Greek island ferry-disruption continuity plan
summary: Prepare for weather or emergency disruption that delays food, medicine, travel, repair parts, and professional access.
content: Field sequence: Track official port and weather notices, protected medicine and water reserves, local health and municipal contacts, accommodation options, charging, cash, and a no-rumour update schedule.
